label: Alpine Bar Chart
description: Alpine bar chart, a friendly mobile-marketing card: rounded bars on an exact scale (every bar lands on its value's gridline), category labels, value labels, value ticks centred on their lines.

values.label: Values
values.description: Numeric data values driving the bars.

labels.label: Category Labels
labels.description: Category labels (index-aligned to values). Optional — clear for a value-only chart.

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.description: Bar orientation: horizontal (bars grow right) or vertical (bars grow up).

barColor.label: Bar Color
barColor.description: Bar fill color. Defaults to the resolved theme primary.

bars.thickness.label: Thickness
bars.thickness.description: Bar width (vertical) / height (horizontal) as a fraction of its band. 1 = bars touch. Overrides Gap when set.

bars.gap.label: Gap
bars.gap.description: Gap between bars as a fraction of bar thickness (legacy inverse of Thickness — ignored when Thickness is set).

bars.label: Bars
bars.description: Bar geometry: gap between bars + cap rounding.

grid.label: Grid
grid.description: Gridlines + value ticks behind the bars.

valueLabels.format.label: Format
valueLabels.format.description: compact = 1.2K; raw = as-is; percent = share of max.

domain.minValue.label: Min Value
domain.minValue.description: Explicit domain minimum. Auto (0 / nice) when unset.

domain.maxValue.label: Max Value
domain.maxValue.description: Explicit domain maximum. Auto (nice max) when unset.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Value-axis domain overrides — leave unset to auto-fit to nice round numbers.

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): bars fade + grow in — a per-pixel geq per bar/label. "light": bars grow opaquely + labels enable-gate pop — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the chart — bars GREEN with the measured rule when every bar is the same thickness (equal height horizontal / equal width vertical), offenders RED with the violation when not. Deterministic default false; production never sets it.
